title: Sgt. Verbeck’s “Barry White” Episode 😂 + NROs: The Blue Notebook Review
description:
This week’s Blue Notebook Review comes with a twist — Sgt. Verbeck is under the weather, but the show must go on… with an unexpected Barry White-style voice that you don’t want to miss.

While he powers through, our Neighborhood Resource Officers cover key highlights from providing updates on community engagement, enforcement activity, and the work happening across Santa Monica neighborhoods.

Stick around for the outtakes — they might be the best part.

As always, thank you for staying informed and engaged with SMPD.
